strings.group.help: Epson RX8130CE real-time clock with battery backup, at 0x32
strings.no_valid_date: The clock is answering but its registers do not decode to a date -- a drained backup cell, or never set. Run 'i2c-rx8130ce set'.
strings.power_lost: Power:    lost since the clock was last set, so the time above may be wrong. 'i2c-rx8130ce set' clears the flag.
strings.set.help: Copy the system time into the clock
strings.system_clock_unset: The system clock is not set, so there is nothing to copy into the RTC. Check 'net status' and let NTP set it.
strings.system_unset: System:   not set; nothing to compare against. NTP sets it once there is a network.
strings.time.help: Read the clock, and compare it with the system time
